# Just a Boring Banker

> Free Canadian personal finance education by Ryan Garneau, a Vancouver, British
> Columbia-based educator who spent 23 years at TD Wealth. Plain-language guides,
> six interactive calculators ("The Machines"), a curated toolkit of official
> Canadian resources, and a YouTube series. Educational content only — not
> financial advice.

## Who
- Ryan Garneau: 23 years at TD Wealth; based in Vancouver, BC, Canada
- About: https://justaboringbanker.com/about.html

## The Machines (free browser calculators, no signup)
- The Hindsight Machine — historical investing outcomes: https://justaboringbanker.com/tools/html_machines/The_Hindsight_Machine.html
- Withdrawal Scenarios — retirement drawdown & sequence risk: https://justaboringbanker.com/tools/html_machines/Withdrawal_Scenarios.html
- Allocation in Action — portfolio mixes & market timing game: https://justaboringbanker.com/tools/html_machines/Allocation_in_Action.html
- Actions vs Consequences — cost of panic selling: https://justaboringbanker.com/tools/html_machines/action_versus_consequences.html
- The Fee Machine — MER fee drag comparison: https://justaboringbanker.com/tools/html_machines/The_Fee_Machine.html
- The Debt Machine — avalanche vs snowball payoff race: https://justaboringbanker.com/tools/html_machines/The_Debt_Machine.html
